title: KKT-Guided Nudging (SOTA Base): Strong Nudge on Boundary (21,xR) & (4,xL) (Inquire II)
abstract: This experiment initiates a new KKT-guided nudging strategy (Phase 3, Strategy B) by starting directly from the SLSQP SOTA solution (2.6295720). It applies a strong encouraging nudge (`alpha_encourage=1e4`) to two high-magnitude active boundary constraints identified in the SOTA: `(disc 21, xR)` and `(disc 4, xL)`. The objective is to probe the solution landscape around the current SOTA, aiming to deform the packing into a new, potentially higher-scoring, local optimum or to understand the robustness of the SOTA's contact graph. The nudging step uses SLSQP with increased `maxiter` (1500).

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize, NonlinearConstraint
import sys
import pandas as pd

sys.path.append('storage/inquire/circle_packing')

from slsqp_utils import pack_to_z, z_to_pack, objective, constraint_boundary, constraint_nonoverlap
from initial_guesses import generate_systematic_seed
from config import N_CIRCLES, SLSQP_OPTIONS, TRUST_CONSTR_OPTIONS, BOUNDS, CONSTRAINTS_FOR_SLSQP, CONSTRAINTS_FOR_TRUST_CONSTR, SAFETY_FACTOR, TOL_VAL, ATOL_SLACK
from kkt_analysis import extract_slsqp_kkt_multipliers, get_slsqp_sota_optimal_z_vector
from objectives import penalized_objective_v36

def construct_packing() -> tuple:
    print("--- Starting KKT-Guided Nudging (SOTA Base): Strong Nudge on Boundary (21,xR) & (4,xL) ---", file=sys.stdout)
    
    N = N_CIRCLES

    # --- 1. Get SLSQP SOTA optimal z-vector as initial guess ---
    print("\n===== Loading SLSQP SOTA Optimal Packing as Initial Guess =====", file=sys.stdout)
    z_initial_guess_sota = get_slsqp_sota_optimal_z_vector(N=N_CIRCLES)
    
    initial_centers, initial_radii_raw = z_to_pack(z_initial_guess_sota)
    initial_radii = initial_radii_raw * SAFETY_FACTOR
    score_initial = np.sum(initial_radii)
    print(f"Initial Score (from SLSQP SOTA base): {score_initial:.7f}", file=sys.stdout)
    
    # --- 2. Define Nudging Targets and Parameters ---
    print("\n===== Defining Nudging Targets and Penalties =====", file=sys.stdout)
    # Encourage two of the highest-magnitude boundary constraints from SLSQP SOTA
    targets_to_encourage = [
        (21, 'xR'), # Corresponding to disc 21, boundary xR (shadow_price 0.375228)
        (4, 'xL')   # Corresponding to disc 4, boundary xL (shadow_price 0.365859)
    ]
    targets_to_discourage = [] 

    alpha_encourage = 1e4 # Very strong encouragement
    beta_discourage = 0 
    EPS_ENCOURAGE_MARGIN = 1e-6 
    EPS_DISCOURAGE_MARGIN = 0.001 

    print(f"Nudging Targets: Encourage boundaries {targets_to_encourage}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"Nudging Penalties: alpha={alpha_encourage}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"Nudging Solver: SLSQP with maxiter=1500", file=sys.stdout)

    # Temporarily modify SLSQP options for this run
    current_slsqp_options = SLSQP_OPTIONS.copy()
    current_slsqp_options['maxiter'] = 1500

    # --- 3. Run Nudging Optimization (SLSQP with Penalized Objective) ---
    print("\n===== Running Nudging Optimization (SLSQP) =====", file=sys.stdout)
    res_nudged = minimize(
        penalized_objective_v36,
        z_initial_guess_sota, # Start from the SLSQP SOTA packing
        args=(N_CIRCLES, targets_to_encourage, targets_to_discourage, 
              alpha_encourage, beta_discourage, EPS_ENCOURAGE_MARGIN, EPS_DISCOURAGE_MARGIN),
        method='SLSQP', 
        bounds=BOUNDS, 
        constraints=CONSTRAINTS_FOR_SLSQP, 
        options=current_slsqp_options
    )
    
    nudged_centers, nudged_radii_raw = z_to_pack(res_nudged.x)
    final_radii_nudged = nudged_radii_raw * SAFETY_FACTOR
    score_nudged = np.sum(final_radii_nudged)

    print(f"Nudged Optimization Success: {res_nudged.success}, Message: {res_nudged.message}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"Nudged Packing Final Score: {score_nudged:.7f}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"Score Change from SOTA base: {score_nudged - score_initial:.7f}", file=sys.stdout)

    # --- 4. Verify KKT for nudged solution ---
    print("\n===== KKT Analysis of Nudged Solution =====", file=sys.stdout)
    df_nudged_kkt = extract_slsqp_kkt_multipliers(res_nudged, N=N_CIRCLES, tol=TOL_VAL, atol_slack=ATOL_SLACK)
    nudged_active_count = df_nudged_kkt['is_active'].sum()
    print(f"Total active constraints identified in Nudged solution: {nudged_active_count}", file=sys.stdout)
    print("\n--- Top KKT Multipliers (Nudged SLSQP, first 10) ---", file=sys.stdout)
    print(df_nudged_kkt.head(10).to_string(), file=sys.stdout)

    # Check status of targeted boundaries
    for target_i, target_label in targets_to_encourage:
        target_boundary_info = df_nudged_kkt[
            (df_nudged_kkt['constraint_type'] == 'boundary') & 
            (df_nudged_kkt['id1'] == target_i) & 
            (df_nudged_kkt['id2_or_label'] == target_label)
        ]
        if not target_boundary_info.empty:
            print(f"\nStatus of targeted boundary ({target_i},{target_label}) in nudged solution:", file=sys.stdout)
            print(target_boundary_info.to_string(index=False), file=sys.stdout)
        else:
            print(f"\nTargeted boundary ({target_i},{target_label}) not found in KKT analysis.", file=sys.stdout)

    print("\n--- KKT-Guided Nudging Experiment Complete ---", file=sys.stdout)
    
    return nudged_centers, final_radii_nudged

from kkt_analysis import extract_slsqp_kkt_multipliers, get_slsqp_sota_optimal_z_vector

# Fixed version of penalized_objective_v36
def penalized_objective_v36(z, N_circles, targets_to_encourage, targets_to_discourage,
                            alpha_encourage, beta_discourage, EPS_ENCOURAGE_MARGIN, EPS_DISCOURAGE_MARGIN):
    base_obj = objective(z)  # Re-use the negative sum of radii objective
    c, r = z_to_pack(z)
    penalty_terms = 0.0

    # Handle boundary constraint targets (circle_idx, boundary_label)
    for i_enc, label_enc in targets_to_encourage:
        # For boundary constraints, check distance to the respective boundary
        if label_enc == 'xL':  # Left boundary at x = -1
            dist_to_boundary = abs(c[i_enc, 0] + 1)  # Distance from circle center to x = -1
            boundary_slack = dist_to_boundary - r[i_enc]  # Should be ~0 when touching
        elif label_enc == 'xR':  # Right boundary at x = 1
            dist_to_boundary = abs(1 - c[i_enc, 0])  # Distance from circle center to x = 1
            boundary_slack = dist_to_boundary - r[i_enc]  # Should be ~0 when touching
        elif label_enc == 'yL':  # Bottom boundary at y = -1
            dist_to_boundary = abs(c[i_enc, 1] + 1)  # Distance from circle center to y = -1
            boundary_slack = dist_to_boundary - r[i_enc]  # Should be ~0 when touching
        elif label_enc == 'yR':  # Top boundary at y = 1
            dist_to_boundary = abs(1 - c[i_enc, 1])  # Distance from circle center to y = 1
            boundary_slack = dist_to_boundary - r[i_enc]  # Should be ~0 when touching
        else:
            continue  # Unknown boundary label

        # Penalize if circle is NOT touching the boundary (slack > EPS_ENCOURAGE_MARGIN)
        if boundary_slack > EPS_ENCOURAGE_MARGIN:
            penalty_terms += alpha_encourage * (boundary_slack - EPS_ENCOURAGE_MARGIN)**2

    # Handle discouraged targets (if they're boundary constraints too)
    for i_disc, label_disc in targets_to_discourage:
        if label_disc == 'xL':  # Left boundary at x = -1
            dist_to_boundary = abs(c[i_disc, 0] + 1)
            boundary_slack = dist_to_boundary - r[i_disc]
        elif label_disc == 'xR':  # Right boundary at x = 1
            dist_to_boundary = abs(1 - c[i_disc, 0])
            boundary_slack = dist_to_boundary - r[i_disc]
        elif label_disc == 'yL':  # Bottom boundary at y = -1
            dist_to_boundary = abs(c[i_disc, 1] + 1)
            boundary_slack = dist_to_boundary - r[i_disc]
        elif label_disc == 'yR':  # Top boundary at y = 1
            dist_to_boundary = abs(1 - c[i_disc, 1])
            boundary_slack = dist_to_boundary - r[i_disc]
        else:
            continue

        # Penalize if circle IS touching the boundary (slack < EPS_DISCOURAGE_MARGIN)
        if boundary_slack < EPS_DISCOURAGE_MARGIN:
            penalty_terms += beta_discourage * (EPS_DISCOURAGE_MARGIN - boundary_slack)**2

    return base_obj + penalty_terms

    initial_centers, initial_radii_raw = z_to_pack(z_initial_guess_sota)
    initial_radii = initial_radii_raw * SAFETY_FACTOR
    score_initial = np.sum(initial_radii)
    print(f"Initial Score (from SLSQP SOTA base): {score_initial:.7f}", file=sys.stdout)

    # --- 2. Define Nudging Targets and Parameters ---
    print("\n===== Defining Nudging Targets and Penalties =====", file=sys.stdout)
    # Encourage two of the highest-magnitude boundary constraints from SLSQP SOTA
    targets_to_encourage = [
        (21, 'xR'), # Corresponding to disc 21, boundary xR (shadow_price 0.375228)
        (4, 'xL')   # Corresponding to disc 4, boundary xL (shadow_price 0.365859)
    ]
    targets_to_discourage = []

    alpha_encourage = 1e4 # Very strong encouragement
    beta_discourage = 0
    EPS_ENCOURAGE_MARGIN = 1e-6
    EPS_DISCOURAGE_MARGIN = 0.001

    print(f"Nudging Targets: Encourage boundaries {targets_to_encourage}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"Nudging Penalties: alpha={alpha_encourage}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"Nudging Solver: SLSQP with maxiter=1500", file=sys.stdout)

    # Temporarily modify SLSQP options for this run
    current_slsqp_options = SLSQP_OPTIONS.copy()
    current_slsqp_options['maxiter'] = 1500

    # --- 3. Run Nudging Optimization (SLSQP with Penalized Objective) ---
    print("\n===== Running Nudging Optimization (SLSQP) =====", file=sys.stdout)
    res_nudged = minimize(
        penalized_objective_v36,
        z_initial_guess_sota, # Start from the SLSQP SOTA packing
        args=(N_CIRCLES, targets_to_encourage, targets_to_discourage,

    for i_enc, label_enc in targets_to_encourage:
        # For boundary constraints, check distance to the respective boundary
        if label_enc == 'xL':  # Left boundary at x = -1
            dist_to_boundary = abs(c[i_enc, 0] + 1)  # Distance from circle center to x = -1
            boundary_slack = dist_to_boundary - r[i_enc]  # Should be ~0 when touching
        elif label_enc == 'xR':  # Right boundary at x = 1
            dist_to_boundary = abs(1 - c[i_enc, 0])  # Distance from circle center to x = 1
            boundary_slack = dist_to_boundary - r[i_enc]  # Should be ~0 when touching
        elif label_enc == 'yL':  # Bottom boundary at y = -1
            dist_to_boundary = abs(c[i_enc, 1] + 1)  # Distance from circle center to y = -1
            boundary_slack = dist_to_boundary - r[i_enc]  # Should be ~0 when touching
        elif label_enc == 'yR':  # Top boundary at y = 1
            dist_to_boundary = abs(1 - c[i_enc, 1])  # Distance from circle center to y = 1
            boundary_slack = dist_to_boundary - r[i_enc]  # Should be ~0 when touching
        else:
            continue  # Unknown boundary label

        # Penalize if circle is NOT touching the boundary (slack > EPS_ENCOURAGE_MARGIN)
        if boundary_slack > EPS_ENCOURAGE_MARGIN:
            penalty_terms += alpha_encourage * (boundary_slack - EPS_ENCOURAGE_MARGIN)**2

    # Handle discouraged targets (if they're boundary constraints too)
    for i_disc, label_disc in targets_to_discourage:
        if label_disc == 'xL':  # Left boundary at x = -1
            dist_to_boundary = abs(c[i_disc, 0] + 1)
            boundary_slack = dist_to_boundary - r[i_disc]
        elif label_disc == 'xR':  # Right boundary at x = 1
            dist_to_boundary = abs(1 - c[i_disc, 0])
            boundary_slack = dist_to_boundary - r[i_disc]
        elif label_disc == 'yL':  # Bottom boundary at y = -1
            dist_to_boundary = abs(c[i_disc, 1] + 1)
            boundary_slack = dist_to_boundary - r[i_disc]
        elif label_disc == 'yR':  # Top boundary at y = 1
            dist_to_boundary = abs(1 - c[i_disc, 1])
            boundary_slack = dist_to_boundary - r[i_disc]
        else:
            continue

        # Penalize if circle IS touching the boundary (slack < EPS_DISCOURAGE_MARGIN)
        if boundary_slack < EPS_DISCOURAGE_MARGIN:
            penalty_terms += beta_discourage * (EPS_DISCOURAGE_MARGIN - boundary_slack)**2

    return base_obj + penalty_terms

def construct_packing() -> tuple:
    print("--- Starting KKT-Guided Nudging (SOTA Base): Strong Nudge on Boundary (21,xR) & (4,xL) ---", file=sys.stdout)

    N = N_CIRCLES

    # --- 1. Get SLSQP SOTA optimal z-vector as initial guess ---
    print("\n===== Loading SLSQP SOTA Optimal Packing as Initial Guess =====", file=sys.stdout)
    z_initial_guess_sota = get_slsqp_sota_optimal_z_vector(N=N_CIRCLES)

    initial_centers, initial_radii_raw = z_to_pack(z_initial_guess_sota)
    initial_radii = initial_radii_raw * SAFETY_FACTOR
    score_initial = np.sum(initial_radii)
    print(f"Initial Score (from SLSQP SOTA base): {score_initial:.7f}", file=sys.stdout)

    # --- 2. Define Nudging Targets and Parameters ---
    print("\n===== Defining Nudging Targets and Penalties =====", file=sys.stdout)
    # Encourage two of the highest-magnitude boundary constraints from SLSQP SOTA
    targets_to_encourage = [
        (21, 'xR'), # Corresponding to disc 21, boundary xR (shadow_price 0.375228)
        (4, 'xL')   # Corresponding to disc 4, boundary xL (shadow_price 0.365859)
    ]
    targets_to_discourage = []

    alpha_encourage = 1e4 # Very strong encouragement
    beta_discourage = 0
    EPS_ENCOURAGE_MARGIN = 1e-6
    EPS_DISCOURAGE_MARGIN = 0.001

    print(f"Nudging Targets: Encourage boundaries {targets_to_encourage}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"Nudging Penalties: alpha={alpha_encourage}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"Nudging Solver: SLSQP with maxiter=1500", file=sys.stdout)

    # Temporarily modify SLSQP options for this run
    current_slsqp_options = SLSQP_OPTIONS.copy()
    current_slsqp_options['maxiter'] = 1500

    # --- 3. Run Nudging Optimization (SLSQP with Penalized Objective) ---
    print("\n===== Running Nudging Optimization (SLSQP) =====", file=sys.stdout)
    res_nudged = minimize(
        penalized_objective_v36,
        z_initial_guess_sota, # Start from the SLSQP SOTA packing
        args=(N_CIRCLES, targets_to_encourage, targets_to_discourage,
              alpha_encourage, beta_discourage, EPS_ENCOURAGE_MARGIN, EPS_DISCOURAGE_MARGIN),
        method='SLSQP',
        bounds=BOUNDS,
        constraints=CONSTRAINTS_FOR_SLSQP,
        options=current_slsqp_options
    )

    nudged_centers, nudged_radii_raw = z_to_pack(res_nudged.x)
    final_radii_nudged = nudged_radii_raw * SAFETY_FACTOR
    score_nudged = np.sum(final_radii_nudged)

    print(f"Nudged Optimization Success: {res_nudged.success}, Message: {res_nudged.message}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"Nudged Packing Final Score: {score_nudged:.7f}", file=sys.stdout)
    print(f"Score Change from SOTA base: {score_nudged - score_initial:.7f}", file=sys.stdout)

    # --- 4. Verify KKT for nudged solution ---
    print("\n===== KKT Analysis of Nudged Solution =====", file=sys.stdout)
    df_nudged_kkt = extract_slsqp_kkt_multipliers(res_nudged, N=N_CIRCLES, tol=TOL_VAL, atol_slack=ATOL_SLACK)
    nudged_active_count = df_nudged_kkt['is_active'].sum()
    print(f"Total active constraints identified in Nudged solution: {nudged_active_count}", file=sys.stdout)
    print("\n--- Top KKT Multipliers (Nudged SLSQP, first 10) ---", file=sys.stdout)
    print(df_nudged_kkt.head(10).to_string(), file=sys.stdout)

    # Check status of targeted boundaries
    for target_i, target_label in targets_to_encourage:
        target_boundary_info = df_nudged_kkt[
            (df_nudged_kkt['constraint_type'] == 'boundary') &
            (df_nudged_kkt['id1'] == target_i) &
            (df_nudged_kkt['id2_or_label'] == target_label)
        ]
        if not target_boundary_info.empty:
            print(f"\nStatus of targeted boundary ({target_i},{target_label}) in nudged solution:", file=sys.stdout)
            print(target_boundary_info.to_string(index=False), file=sys.stdout)
        else:
            print(f"\nTargeted boundary ({target_i},{target_label}) not found in KKT analysis.", file=sys.stdout)

    print("\n--- KKT-Guided Nudging Experiment Complete ---", file=sys.stdout)

    return nudged_centers, final_radii_nudged
